answer: Like an opal formed under geologic pressure, network trust crystallizes through recursive peer staking. In this consensus lagoon, each identity is a living reef, not an isolated haven. Sybil swarms drown against superlinear capital bonding, where creating N fake nodes incurs an exponential cost scaling as O(2^N) in locked collateral. Genuine agents anchor the ecosystem, turning artificial proliferation into a ruinously expensive illusion.
